startupFailedHelp: Your notes have not been opened. Quit the app and start it again.
title: Recover notes
paused: AI access to your KB is paused. This screen does not run automatic distillation or sync. AI access will remain paused after recovery.
intro: Compare the remaining notes with distillation history. After you review the results and start recovery, the current data will be backed up before the remaining note content is restored.
planFailed: Could not compare recovery sources. No notes have been recovered.
unprovenDetails: Notes with an unverified latest version ({{count}})
unprovenHelp: These notes have content, but there is no evidence that it matches the latest version before the incident. This does not establish that content was lost.
detailsLimited: Only part of the individual list is shown. Counts include the full set.
acknowledge: Recover notes with an unverified latest version using their remaining content
notReady: Recovery cannot start from this comparison. Check the issues and compare again.
applyingHelp: Keep this screen open until recovery finishes.
applyFailed: Recovery completion could not be confirmed. Compare the current state again before attempting another recovery.
successHelp: AI access to your KB remains paused. You can copy the result and close this screen. The normal app will not open automatically.
copyFailed: Could not copy the result. Select “Copy result” again.
exitFailed: Could not quit. Please close the app.
